- Enhanced spacing (mb-8 headline, mb-12 subheading)

- Added .dynamic-page-content spacing (3rem between components)
- Enhanced hover transitions for feature cards
- Smooth scrolling enabled globally
- Better fade-in animations

**Core Architecture:**
- src/app/page.tsx - Client component with state management
- src/components/organisms/ImprovedChatWidget.tsx - NEW 3-mode widget
- src/components/organisms/ChatInterface.tsx - Removed internal page rendering
- src/components/organisms/FloatingChatWidget.tsx - Added callback prop

**Component Improvements:**
- src/components/dynamic/FeatureGrid.tsx - Icon mapping system
- src/components/dynamic/HeroSection.tsx - Enhanced styling and spacing
- src/components/organisms/DynamicPageRenderer.tsx - Better spacing defaults

**System Enhancements:**
- src/lib/page-generation-prompts.ts - Critical layout guidelines
- src/lib/page-validation.ts - Recursive sanitization
